world.title: Obasanjo Says Tinubu, ECOWAS Mishandling Of Niger Coup Pushed Three Sahel Nations Out Of Bloc
world.description: Former Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo has criticised the handling of the military coup in Niger Republic by the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), saying the regional bloc’s response contributed to a deterioration in relations and the withdrawal of Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso from the organisation. Obasanjo made the remarks during an interview at the Harvard Kennedy School’s Institute of Politics, monitored by SaharaReporters on Tuesday night, while assessing insecurity and political instability across Africa.
